title: Detecting 16S rRNA Gene Fragments from a Metagenome to Assemble Full-Length 16S Sequences
author: Benjamin Tully
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.d7u9nv

steps.title: Convert FASTQ to merged FASTA
steps.instruction: Run fq2fa to interweave paired‑end reads and remove any sequences containing Ns, producing a merged FASTA file.

substeps.instruction: --merge interweaves R1 then R2 reads; --filter discards reads with Ns.

steps.title: Detect SSU rRNA fragments
steps.instruction: Use Meta‑RNA (rna_hmm3.py) with the supplied HMM3 models to identify small‑subunit rRNA fragments in the merged FASTA.

substeps.instruction: -L points to the HMM3 directory, -m selects SSU only, -e sets E‑value cutoff to 1 × 10⁻¹⁰, -p uses 36 CPUs.

steps.title: Extract 16S reads from R1
steps.instruction: Trim the original R1 FASTQ using the Meta‑RNA output table to keep only predicted 16S fragments.

substeps.instruction: The resulting file will be named OUTFILE_PREFIX1.001.metagenome16S.fastq.

steps.title: Extract 16S reads from R2
steps.instruction: Repeat the trimming for the R2 paired‑end reads.

substeps.instruction: The output file will be OUTFILE_PREFIX2.001.metagenome16S.fastq.

steps.title: Combine 16S FASTQ files
steps.instruction: Merge the generated .metagenome16S.fastq files as desired (e.g., concatenate paired fragments or all fragments from the sample).

steps.title: Install EMIRGE dependencies
steps.instruction: Ensure the following software packages are installed before running EMIRGE:

steps.title: Download SILVA reference database
steps.instruction: Obtain the EMIRGE candidate SSU reference database using the provided script.

steps.title: Correct reference database characters
steps.instruction: Run the EMIRGE script to replace non‑standard characters in the downloaded FASTA.

steps.title: Build Bowtie index for reference
steps.instruction: Create a Bowtie index from the corrected reference FASTA.

steps.title: Assemble full‑length 16S with EMIRGE
steps.instruction: Run EMIRGE in amplicon mode on the combined 16S FASTQ file, specifying reference files and assembly parameters.

substeps.instruction: -1 = input FASTQ (single‑end; add -2 for paired‑end if desired)
-s = standard deviation of insert size (88 bp)
The command creates ./emirgeWorkingDir; delete or rename this directory before re‑running.

steps.title: Rename final EMIRGE FASTA
steps.instruction: Inside the EMIRGE working directory, generate the final FASTA file with the provided renaming script.

steps.title: Assign taxonomy with mothur (optional)
steps.instruction: Classify the assembled 16S sequences using mothur with a reference alignment and taxonomy file.

substeps.instruction: classify.seqs(fasta=INPUT.16S.pick.align, template=reference.database.fasta, taxonomy=reference.database.tax, cutoff=80, iters=1000, processors=64)
flip=T searches both forward and reverse; cutoff=80 % confidence; iters=1000 for robustness.
